subject.title: fix(voice-call): bound diagnostic JSONL reads to prevent OOM on large logs

question: Should voice-call diagnostics intentionally discard one JSONL record larger than the 1 MB diagnostic limit in exchange for bounded memory use?
rationale: The PR describes this as the availability policy, but the provided evidence does not establish whether operators rely on exceptionally large diagnostic records being emitted intact.

options.title: Accept bounded-record policy
options.body: Merge after a current-main refresh, treating records over 1 MB as intentionally non-diagnostic input to keep the CLI memory-bounded.

options.title: Preserve oversized records
options.body: Ask for a different streamed-output design if complete oversized diagnostic records are a required operator contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded-record policy
recommendation.body: Merge after a current-main refresh, treating records over 1 MB as intentionally non-diagnostic input to keep the CLI memory-bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history for the voice-call CLI could not be inspected in the available read-only environment.
